faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person to engage in business in the city without first
               having obtained a business license, which shall be granted at no charge and issued
               by the city clerk upon the filing of an application in the form prescribed by the
               enforcement officer. Such business license shall be in force until revoked or transferred
               as provided in this article. A business license shall be applied for and issued in
               the name of the person and at the specific address of the applicant. A separate business
               license shall be applied for and issued for each location if more than one location
               is used by the applicant in the conduct of business of sales at retail.
(b)
The finance director may establish a fee in the manner provided in chapter 2,
section 2-262
of this Code for the renewal of a business license. If a fee is imposed for renewal
               of a business license, failure to pay such fee in the amount and at the time required
               shall be the basis for suspension or revocation of a business license as provided
               in
section 98-65
of this chapter.
(Code 1981, § 31-38; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002;
Ord. No. 4317, § 6, 3-5-2012
;
Ord. No. 4548, § 2, 5-2-2016
)
